summary.decision_summary: Bend & Snap Count won by 31.8. Bend & Snap Count left 21.4 lineup points on the table, while Nacua-Cola left 40.9.
summary.historical_summary: Bend & Snap Count is 16-23 against Nacua-Cola across 39 meetings between these managers.
summary.ideal_summary: Ideal lineups still favor Bend & Snap Count
summary.winner_reason: Bend & Snap Count won by 31.8, led by a 10.2-point edge at RB. The leading starters were CeeDee Lamb (35.3) and Joe Burrow (24.9).
summary.loser_reason: Nacua-Cola could not match the opponent's RB production, losing that position battle by 10.2 points. Ladd McConkey scored 0.0. Its best legal lineup added 40.9, enough to put the lineup decisions directly in the result.
